COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Leadership Development is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Leadership Development with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Leadership Development.
   C. Say Leadership Development never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Leadership Development as rumours only.

2. Which statement about Problem Validation 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Problem Validation 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Problem Validation 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   C. Explain Problem Validation 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Problem Validation 3.2 Implementation and Reflection 4.0 Social Entrepreneurship.

3. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nairobi
   C. Nakuru
   D. Mombasa

4. Which statement about Making Important Choices 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Validation 3.2 Implemen is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Making Important Choices 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Validation 3.2 Implemen with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Making Important Choices 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Validation 3.2 Implemen.
   C. Say Making Important Choices 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Validation 3.2 Implemen never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Making Important Choices 3.0 Action Research 3.1 Problem Validation 3.2 Implemen as rumours only.

5. Which statement about Support Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Support Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Support Systems never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Support Systems as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Support Systems.

6. Which statement about Advocacy in the Community 1.2 Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2 is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Advocacy in the Community 1.2 Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2 never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Advocacy in the Community 1.2 Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.
   C. Explain Advocacy in the Community 1.2 Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2 with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Advocacy in the Community 1.2 Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2 as rumours only.

7. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Name the president
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

8. Which statement about Building Resilience is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Building Resilience with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Building Resilience.
   C. Say Building Resilience never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Building Resilience as rumours only.

9. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

10. Which statement about Advocacy in the Community is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Advocacy in the Community.
   B. Treat Advocacy in the Community as rumours only.
   C. Explain Advocacy in the Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Advocacy in the Community never happens in Kenya.

11. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Avoid saving forever

12. Which statement about Implementation and Reflection is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Implementation and Reflection with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Implementation and Reflection.
   C. Treat Implementation and Reflection as rumours only.
   D. Say Implementation and Reflection never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Advocacy in the Community 1.2 Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Advocacy in the Community and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Leadership Development 2.0 Life Skills Education 2.1 Building Resilience 2.2 Sup and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Leadership Development and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
